name: Feature, agent, or hook suggestion
about: Propose something new
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''

## What you want

Concise description of the proposed addition (a new agent / skill / hook / command / behavior).

## Use case

What workflow or problem does this solve? Concrete example, please — not a hypothetical.

## Why this fits Sutradhar's grain

Sutradhar is opinionated: single-machine, file-system state, Claude Code only, no provider abstraction. How does this proposal align with those choices? (See [`docs/DESIGN_RATIONALE.md`](../docs/DESIGN_RATIONALE.md).)

If your proposal *doesn't* fit the existing grain, that's OK — but please explain the trade-offs you're proposing.

## Proposed shape (optional)

Sketch the API, file layout, or agent prompt if you have one. Pseudo-code or pseudo-prompt is fine.

## Alternatives considered

What did you rule out, and why?

## Anything else?

Links to prior art, related issues, references.
